text:
deploy-bot: starting deploy v1.12.3 -> prod (change-window 02A). Targets: all regions, staggered 10m per region. Rollout ID: r-2026-03-20-02A :rocket:
maya (SRE): :eyes: watching SLO dashboards, will post anomalies. KV cache warmup enabled for this release.
sam (runtime): note: new kernel selector change in this build, should reduce tail latency for long-context.
maya (SRE): seeing p95 spike on embed-service in us-east at +18% vs baseline, dashboard: https://dash.redwood/s/embed-slo?p=us-east :warning:
liam (releases): pinging deploy-bot to pause region eu-west if errors appear. Can we pin previous model variant there?
deploy-bot: rollout paused for eu-west (manual pause by liam). Current rollout state: us-east active, eu-west paused, ap-south queued.
anya (oncall): I have the incident window open. Linking quicktrace for the spike: https://trace.redwood/t/abc1234. Error traces show a handful of 500s with model shard OOMs.
sam (runtime): OOMs correlate with requests > 8k tokens. New kernel had a regression for very long sequences. Rolling back kernel on eu-west makes sense.
maya (SRE): SLO alert rule shows 5xx rate exceeded 0.5% over 5m in us-east, p95 latency +18% but p99 unchanged. Recommend canary rollback for long-seq kernel only.
liam (releases): agreed — pin eu-west to v1.12.2 for now and rollback kernel in us-east canary. I'll update release notes and create a follow-up changelog entry.
deploy-bot: executing pin: /deploy pin r-2026-03-20-02A --region eu-west --version v1.12.2 — pinned by liam :white_check_mark:
observability-bot: ALERT muted for pinned regions. Notifying oncall.
anya (oncall): running synthetic checks on rerouted traffic to v1.12.2 in eu-west, will report within 3 minutes.
sam (runtime): initiating rollback for kernel variant in us-east canary: /deploy rollback --rollout-id r-2026-03-20-02A --component kernel-selector --region us-east --to 1.12.2
maya (SRE): after rollback, p95 back to baseline, 5xx dropped to 0.08%. Good catch everyone.
liam (releases): adding note to release thread: "hotfix: reverted kernel-selector optimization for long-context until patch lands". Will schedule follow-up patch in next sprint.
anya (oncall): leaving eu-west pinned until next deploy window and until regression is validated. :lock:
deploy-bot: rollout resumed for ap-south, eu-west remains pinned. Rollout status: us-east stable, eu-west pinned, ap-south in-progress.
maya (SRE): closing SLO watch for this window — will open postmortem doc if regression reproduces during extended traffic.
liam (releases): thumbs up — will notif product and docs about the temporary rollback in release notes. :thumbsup:
